text:
London gets far more rain than hot or dry cities such as Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Dubai and Riyadh (roughly 100 mm each), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), Los Angeles (about 370 mm), and Madrid (about 440 mm), while London averages roughly 600 mm. The team note saying London gets around 1,500 mm a year is wrong; that is about 2.5 times the actual average. These are approximate long-term averages that I haven't checked against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 85
